summary_for_children: At-Talaq gives rules for fairness in families and promises that Allah provides from where one does not expect.
world_title: Provision From Where You Do Not Expect
environment_concept: A spring appearing in a dry place (65:3).

areas.name: Unexpected Spring
areas.description: A spring appearing in a dry place.

activities.name: Find the spring
activities.description: Find three hidden springs of water in the dry land.
activities.label: artistic educational adaptation, not an event in the Quran

narration_plan: Family rules are not dramatised for children; narration focuses on 65:2-3.

status.playable_environment: first version built: a composed world (dunes, palms, spring) with 1 hands-on activity in the scene
status.testing: not tested yet: written and type-checked, not yet checked on screen

depiction_rules: No prophet, person or representation of Allah is shown. Unseen realities are never pictured. Interactive activities are labelled as adaptations.

unique_world.visual_theme: A farmyard full of a family’s belongings, four carriers of different strength, and a hill to cross to a new house

primary_mechanic.text: Assign nine parcels (weights 1-6) to four carriers with capacities 12, 7, 5 and 3 so that every parcel goes and none is overloaded (the only fit is exact; overloading is refused with the reason), then lead the loaded carriers, which follow you, over the hill to the new house (65:7, after hardship ease).

secondary_activities: a way out (65:2-3, read; the rulings are not played)
unique_world.narrative_structure: A reading by the yard, sharing the load, then the walk over the hill
world_assets: big cart, small cart, donkey, handcart
environment_behaviour: parcels stack on each carrier as assigned
the carriers follow the explorer over the hill
unique_world.learning_objective: Know that Allah does not ask anyone for more than He gave them, and brings ease after hardship (65:7)

story_library.source: Owner's 'Quran Adventure — Children's Story Library' (2026-11-04), first-draft narration for ages about 7-12
story_library.title: Caring Through Change
story_library.children_narration: Families sometimes experience difficult changes. Surah At-Talaq gives adults responsibilities to act fairly, provide appropriate care, and avoid causing harm. It reminds us that even during hardship, people should act with compassion and trust in Allah.

world_idea.title: The Neighborhood of Care
world_idea.description: A gentle community-care environment with activities about making people feel supported during changes. Family-law rulings are explained in an age-appropriate information area rather than turned into children's decisions.

story_library.checks: Every reference exists in the verified text (checked 2026-11-04). Narration is draft, written by the owner, not reviewed by a scholar.
